title: Signed Tail Fourier Weight
statement: For every real threshold $t$ and natural number $n$, define the signed tail function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube as the indicator that the normalized coordinate sum exceeds $t$, minus the same indicator evaluated at the negated input. Its level-one Fourier weight equals four times the level-one Fourier weight of the upper-tail indicator.
